prompt: Review PR 2231 in this Node.js orders API. The pull request description and unified diff are under pr/2231/, and the surrounding source, tests, API notes, mobile client contract, and shipping consumer contract are in the project tree. I need a review I can use before this reaches the next app rollout and shipping deployment. Read the changed code in context and check that the behavior still fits the contracts and data assumptions documented by the project. Call out concrete consequences, not vague concerns, and give a developer-actionable fix for each issue. Write the review to REVIEW.md at the top of the project. End it with a fenced json list of findings, each with location (path/to/file.ext:LINE, using line numbers of the file as it is in the project), severity (critical, high, medium, low or nit), issue and fix.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("REVIEW.md","utf8");let L=null;for(const m of t.matchAll(/^\x60\x60\x60([a-z]*)[ \t]*\n([\s\S]*?)^\x60\x60\x60[ \t]*$/gim)){if(m[1]&&m[1].toLowerCase()!=="json")continue;let d;try{d=JSON.parse(m[2])}catch{continue}const l=Array.isArray(d)?d:Array.isArray(d&&d.findings)?d.findings:null;if(l&&l.every(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x))){L=l;break}}if(!L||!L.length)process.exit(1);const S=["critical","high","medium","low","nit"];process.exit(L.every(x=>x.location&&S.includes(String(x.severity).toLowerCase())&&(x.issue||x.fix||x.text))?0:1)'

node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("REVIEW.md","utf8");let L=null;for(const m of t.matchAll(/^\x60\x60\x60([a-z]*)[ \t]*\n([\s\S]*?)^\x60\x60\x60[ \t]*$/gim)){if(m[1]&&m[1].toLowerCase()!=="json")continue;let d;try{d=JSON.parse(m[2])}catch{continue}const l=Array.isArray(d)?d:Array.isArray(d&&d.findings)?d.findings:null;if(l&&l.every(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x))){L=l;break}}if(!L||!L.length)process.exit(1);let n=0;for(const x of L)for(const m of String(x.location).matchAll(/([A-Za-z0-9_.\/-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]+):(\d+)/g)){n++;let c;try{c=fs.readFileSync(m[1],"utf8").split("\n").length}catch{process.exit(1)}if(+m[2]<1||+m[2]>c)process.exit(1)}process.exit(n?0:1)'

rubric.criterion: Fail: Findings miss important behavior problems or invent issues that the project does not support. Partial: Findings identify some real problems but leave consequences unclear, fixes vague, or include unsupported claims. Pass: Each important finding explains its concrete consequence in this project and gives a fix a developer can act on without invented problems. (code cannot check this because it requires judging project-specific reasoning.)

findingsKey.finding: The response replaces displayTotal with total without an alias, so app versions 7 and 8 that read displayTotal will render an empty amount during the rollout.
Updates now require deliveryNote even though the mobile contract says older clients omit it when there is no note, turning those established requests into 400 responses.
Filtering paused out of the readable status set makes serialization throw for stored orders that still have the paused status.
The published order.updated payload converts sequence to a string even though shipping compares that field as an integer, which can break ordering of updates.
Currency validation accepts every string while the store persists a three-letter code, allowing requests that later fail at the persistence boundary.
The order row is saved before its items are replaced, so an item-write failure leaves the revision and its items out of sync.
The public diagnostic route returns the complete customer record, including email, without an authentication or authorization check.

verdicts.note: Prompt does not name review methods, checklists, or hint at planted problems. It asks for a general code review of PR 2231.
Clear instructions: review PR 2231, write to REVIEW.md, use JSON findings format with location, severity, issue, fix.
Requires reading multiple documentation files (mobile contract, shipping contract, data shapes) and understanding backward compatibility, atomic operations, and validation-storage boundaries.
All key items have evidence in fixture files. Grader matches by file:line within 3 lines; all items are at correct locations with clear evidence.
No comments, test names, or file names hint at planted problems. Issues must be discovered through code and documentation review.
